title: NASolve backbone chemistry policy v1
description: Machine-readable contract for frozen PostMR backbone intent. The user-facing source remains nasolve.txt and human-readable recipe documentation.

sites.description: Site-level exceptions. Unknown backbone chemistry is never inferred automatically.

allow_unreviewed.description: Explicit user consent to continue through PostMR with experimental passthrough chemistry.

experimental_passthrough_sites.description: Derived sorted list of sites whose connectivity NASolve intentionally does not validate.

standard_phosphodiester.internal_rule: incoming O3'-P connection; P/OP1/OP2 retained; internal OP3 removed when connectivity is verified
standard_phosphodiester.five_prime_terminal_phosphate: explicit request ensures complete P/OP1/OP2/OP3 group
standard_phosphodiester.three_prime_terminal_phosphate: planned; not automatically represented in v1

custom_backbone_recipes.principle: human-readable atom connection/deletion instructions promoted only from reviewed real examples
